Hojai Girls' College, Hojai, Assam

   Admission Prospectus (Session 2026–2027)

          Higher Secondary (H.S.) 1st Year &
          FYUGP 1st Semester (Arts Stream)



1. Introduction :

Hojai Girls' College invites applications from eligible candidates for admission
into Higher Secondary (Arts) and Four Year Undergraduate Programme (FYUGP)
– Arts Stream for the academic session 2026–2027. The college is committed to
providing quality education and holistic development opportunities for young
women.

2. Intake Capacity :

H.S. 1st Year (Arts): 200 seats

FYUGP 1st Semester (Arts): 700 seats

3. Admission Criteria :

Admissions will be strictly based on merit and conducted in accordance with the
Government reservation policy.
 4. FYUGP Programme Structure :

Admission to FYUGP will follow a Single Major + Single Minor system.

4.1 Core Subjects (Major & Minor)

Students must select:

One Major Subject
One Minor Subject

Available Subjects:
Assamese
Bengali
English
Hindi
Manipuri
Education
Economics
Philosophy
Political Science
History



4.2 Important Restriction

Two literature subjects cannot be selected together as core subjects.

4.3 Seat Allocation

Admission will be granted based on subject-wise seat capacity as per the approved
subject combination matrix of the college. (Annexure -1)
 5. Additional Courses (Compulsory for FYUGP Students)

In addition to Major and Minor subjects, students must opt for the following
courses:



5.1 Ability Enhancement Course (AEC)

To be selected from language/literature subjects:

Assamese
Bengali
English
Hindi
Manipuri




5.2 Multidisciplinary Course (MDC)

To be selected from social science subjects and must be different from core
subjects:

Education
Economics
History
Political Science



5.3 Skill Enhancement Course (SEC)

Must be chosen in alignment with the selected Major subject.
 5.4 Value Added Course (VAC)

Common for all students: Environmental Studies

6. General Instructions

Applicants are advised to carefully choose subject combinations.

Admission is subject to verification of documents.

Any discrepancy may lead to cancellation of admission.

The college reserves the right to make necessary changes as per government
guidelines.



7. Contact Information
Sumita Debnath, Convener Admission committee
Contact No. - 8638798530
Hojai Girls' College
Hojai, Assam


***For further details, students are advised to visit the college office or official
website of the College.***
